---
name: Enhancement Request
about: Suggest a new feature.
labels: enhancement
---

## Request Overview
- Provide a brief description of the feature enhancement or new feature being requested.

## Background
- Explain why this request is important and the background of this problem or requirement.

## Expected Benefits
- Describe the specific results or expected effects from this change.

## Possible Solutions
- If there are proposed solutions to this problem, describe them here. Multiple approaches can be presented with their pros and cons.

## Additional Resources
- Attach screenshots, links, reference documents, or any other relevant information that helps understand this request better.
